genes.prompt_mechanism: interactive_agent.select_action appends a strategy line only for plan_and_solve / tree_search / reflexion; 'cot' and 'direct' get NO strategy instruction beyond the label 'Planner: <name>'
genes.execution_note: BehavioralAgent._plan changes synthetic step tags (not used in native ALFWorld EpisodeRunner path). InteractiveAgent has no plan structure.

MemoryStore.write/read rules differ by strategy: none=disabled; short_term=items[-1:] ONLY LAST ONE; other strategies=items[-k:] k=3. Written item is only 'obs:<120 chars>' — NO action, feedback, or progress field.
genes.measurable_behavior_delta: short_term keeps 1 obs line; episodic/semantic/hybrid keep up to 3; none keeps 0 — real prompt input difference

genes.execution_note: InteractiveAgent reflects ONLY when parsed action is None (parse failure) and strategy != 'none'. A legal-but-stagnant action NEVER triggers reflection. All non-none strategies share the SAME retry prompt — no per-strategy logic.
genes.measurable_behavior_delta: none vs non-none: extra LLM call on parse failure; self_critique/pairwise/critic_model/iterative are behaviorally identical

genes.execution_note: InteractiveAgent sets self.allow = ALLOW_TOOLS[...] but NEVER consults self.allow when selecting ALFWorld actions. Admissible commands come from the environment. ALLOW_TOOLS lists calculator/search/file_* which are NOT ALFWorld verbs. tool_policy is a NO-OP on the native path.
genes.measurable_behavior_delta: none on native ALFWorld EpisodeRunner path

genes.execution_note: BudgetMeter.from_reasoning_budget: max_steps=round(horizon*(0.5+b/128)); max_tokens=max(64, b*12). Each LLM call charges steps=1 (reflection charges another step). Budget gates episode length, not reasoning depth.
genes.measurable_behavior_delta: changes max environment/LLM steps → changes cost and truncation; does NOT change per-step decision quality

note: PROMPT_ONLY != useless; it means no execution-mechanism change. Native path = InteractiveAgent via EpisodeRunner.
